##### Project general facts

Topaz Residences is a prestigious development by Eagle Hills. This thirteen-storey building features a curated collection of one to four-bedroom apartments and luxury three to four-bedroom townhouses, housed within a ground floor, a two-level podium, and residential floors. The design draws inspiration from the region's traditional architecture, reimagined through a contemporary lens, with a clean, minimalist façade and a timeless palette of beige and brown tones that seamlessly combines distinguished conventional architectural practices with modern amenities.

Residents enjoy access to premium amenities designed for tranquil and lavish coastal living, including separate children's and adult swimming pools, a fully equipped fitness center, a children's playground, and a landscaped green park with walking and jogging trails. The beach and scenic waterfront promenade are just a short stroll away, while the development is equipped with round-the-clock video surveillance and high-speed internet connectivity for peace of mind. Each residence includes a private balcony with breathtaking waterfront views and an assigned parking space.

Every residence at Topaz Residences blends modern design solutions with the warmth of natural materials. Interiors feature gypsum ceilings in bathrooms, kitchens, and corridors, with painted ceilings in living rooms and bedrooms. High-quality industrial wood and laminate finishes are used for doors, cupboards, and wardrobes. Kitchens are equipped with modern MDF panels, base and overhead cabinets with laminated finishes, solid surface countertops with glass backsplashes, and premium fixtures. Bathrooms feature shower spaces with glass partitions, acrylic bathtubs, and high-quality sanitaryware, ensuring a seamless and sophisticated living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Maryam Island, a premier waterfront destination in Sharjah, this exceptional location offers a blend of modern luxury and natural beauty. The island is strategically positioned in the heart of downtown Sharjah to offer residents and visitors easy access to the city's key attractions while providing a serene coastal retreat.

The location is distinguished by its extensive waterfront promenade, beautifully landscaped and perfect for leisurely strolls, jogging, or simply relaxing by the water. The promenade is lined with cafes, restaurants, and retail outlets, creating a vibrant social hub. The beach and scenic waterfront are just a short walk away, while Expo Centre Sharjah, Dubai International Airport, and the iconic Burj Khalifa are all within easy reach, ensuring excellent connectivity to the rest of Sharjah and the neighboring emirates.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, modern convenience, and a prime Sharjah location, Maryam Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of scenic beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can escape the hustle and bustle of city life — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
